# Vendored markdown-it

- Package: `markdown-it`
- Version: `15.0.0`
- Source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.0.tgz`
- npm integrity: `sha512-Lf8ajvVNdRpzSNB4VegxNy7gjs8gU35l4b4+ET49LrQC5PKYwLZ72u60LeJ9gv3qiaesuYjJWCyVeQmv/QWKQw==`
- License: MIT; see `markdown-it.LICENSE.txt`

`markdown-it.umd.min.js` is the unmodified browser UMD bundle from the package.
`render_report.py` embeds it into the generated report so the report remains a
single file and does not need network access at runtime.
